dataset.name: BRCA1 / BRCA2 variant pathogenicity
dataset.description: Every classified BRCA1 and BRCA2 variant in ClinVar, described by molecular features derived from the HGVS notation: consequence class, Grantham chemical distance, hydropathy and charge shifts, functional-domain membership and splice proximity.
dataset.notes: Collapsed to one row per variant before splitting; 37,170 duplicate assembly rows removed. 15,581 unresolved variants held out for the VUS Resolver.

stages.detail: No constant columns found
0.00% of cells were missing; filled with the training-set median
Clipped the outer 1% of each tail; 0.39% of values adjusted
Zero mean and unit variance, fitted on the training split
Kept every feature
PCA to 8 components, retaining 70.9% of variance
Rescaled to [0, pi] and encoded on 8 qubits via a ZZFeatureMap with full entanglement

kernel_diagnostics.verdict: The kernel concentrates as qubits are added — off-diagonal spread collapses, so the quantum kernel carries little usable structure on this dataset.

dataset.name: Breast cancer — diagnostic imaging features
dataset.description: Thirty morphological features — radius, texture, concavity and their worst-case statistics — computed from digitised images of fine-needle aspirates of a breast mass.
dataset.notes: The canonical benchmark for quantum-kernel classification papers.

dataset.name: Coronary artery disease
dataset.source: UCI Heart Disease (Cleveland), Detrano et al.
dataset.description: Thirteen routine clinical measurements — resting blood pressure, cholesterol, exercise-induced angina, ST depression and vessel counts — used to predict angiographic coronary disease.
dataset.notes: Contains genuine missing values, which the imputation stage handles.

dataset.name: Parkinson's disease — voice biomarkers
dataset.description: Twenty-two acoustic measures of sustained phonation — jitter, shimmer, harmonic-to-noise ratio and nonlinear dynamical measures — recorded from 31 people, 23 with Parkinson's.
dataset.notes: Small and high-dimensional: 195 recordings against 22 features, the low-data regime where quantum kernels are argued to help.

dataset.name: Type 2 diabetes onset
dataset.description: Eight routine measurements — plasma glucose, BMI, blood pressure, serum insulin and family history — recorded to predict diabetes onset within five years.
dataset.notes: Zeros in glucose, blood pressure, skin fold, insulin and BMI are recording gaps rather than real values, so they are restored to missing before imputation.
